decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler sits at the core of the firm's heat-exchange offer and is publicly listed, so management reads modest uptake as ramp-up and stays committed.
The air cooled condenser fits the announced efficiency direction and carries sunk engineering investment, so persistence is favored.
Despite overlap with Product B, management justifies the second condenser as serving distinct applications rather than admit the duplication by withdrawing it.
The tube liner strengthens the lifecycle service business the firm emphasizes, so any weak results are attributed to temporary causes.
The multi-model customized air cooler line embodies the firm's customized-solutions promise and heavy investment, making withdrawal very unlikely.
The tube end repair inserts are cheap to maintain and support the firm's service and lifecycle commitments to customers.
